props.gloss_en: the mishna: a large reed mat made for lying on is susceptible to impurity and one may not roof with it
the mishna: [made] for roofing -- one roofs with it, and it is not susceptible
R' Eliezer: small and large alike, made for lying on -- susceptible, and one may not roof with it
R' Eliezer: [made] for roofing -- one roofs with it, and it is not susceptible (small and large alike)
the stam: the reason [it is unfit] is that he made it for lying -- so an undesignated one is for roofing
the stam: the reason [it is fit] is that he made it for roofing -- so an undesignated one is for lying
the stam's answer: here [the reisha] -- a large mat: undesignated, it is for roofing
the stam's answer: there [the seifa] -- a small mat: undesignated, it is for lying
the stam, on R' Eliezer: the reason is that he made it for lying -- so an undesignated one, small or large, is for roofing
the stam, on R' Eliezer's seifa: the reason is that he made it for roofing -- so an undesignated one is for lying
Rava: regarding a large mat everyone agrees that undesignated it is for roofing
Rava: where they dispute is a small mat
Rava: the tanna kamma holds an undesignated small mat is for lying
Rava: R' Eliezer holds an undesignated small mat is also for roofing

the baraita: a large reed mat -- one roofs with it
R' Eliezer: [only] if it is not susceptible to impurity may one roof with it
Rav Pappa: regarding a small mat everyone agrees that undesignated it is for lying
Rav Pappa: where they dispute is a large mat
Rav Pappa: the tanna kamma holds an undesignated large mat is for roofing

the stam's reading of R' Eliezer's 'made it for lying': the undesignated making of it is also for lying, until one makes it for roofing

of reeds or of chilat, large -- one roofs with it

R' Dosa: all chotzalot become impure with corpse impurity
the Sages: [they become impure with] midras
the mishna: whatever becomes impure with midras becomes impure with corpse impurity
the stam: read [the Sages' words as] 'even midras'
what are chotzalot? Rav Avdimi bar Hamduri: marzovlei
what are marzovlei? R' Abba: mazblei
R' Shimon ben Lakish: actual mats

...and those of Tiberias -- that they are pure
...over what did they dispute? over [the mats of] other places
one master holds: since no one sits on them, they are like those of Tiberias

the stam: this [R' Dosa's corpse impurity, the mishna] -- of one that has an upturned edge
the stam: that [R' Dosa's agreement in the baraita] -- of one that has no upturned edge

the Sages: even midras
